Each NAME.json is the stdout of `atlc run examples/NAME.toml` and NAME.args the args of `atlc spec examples/NAME.toml --json` (one per line, the examples directory written @EXAMPLES@), from atlc 27b912a against algotradelib a08fb97.
@EXAMPLES@ is now cmdatl's examples/, copies of atlc 0fad370's examples, which differ from 27b912a's in comments only.
This first recording cannot be repeated as written: `atlc run` and `atlc spec` are gone from atlc, and 27b912a reads neither today's specs (the `[bars]` table, `replay.fill = "decision-close"`, `bars.open_point`) nor today's programs (the built-ins' new names); universe.json and universe.args already come from cmdatl's own driver (below).
To record again after the examples, the replay or the library change, write cmdatl's own output over these files, with an atlc that has the new names (9090625 or later): NAME.json is the standard output and NAME.args the arguments, one per line, of the backtest driver `cmdatl strategy backtest examples/NAME.toml` builds and runs, as the acceptance case records them through a stand-in named by `CMDATL_TEST_BACKTEST_DRIVER` (tests/test-acceptance.cpp; only a build defining `CMDATL_RUN_TEST_HOOKS`, as test-cli, reads it), the examples directory replaced by @EXAMPLES@.
universe.json and universe.args were recorded again from cmdatl's own backtest driver when `replay.fill = "legs"` gave way to `data.open_point` (now `bars.open_point`), `replay.market = "us"` and the decision-close rule (`examples/decision-close.hpp`): the same 520 fills and closing equity; two bars a day instead of three (bars, per-period ratios, gaps, first and last bar change); the caveats gain the rule and the session counts.
On 2026-11-05 every `data.*` argument in the `.args` files was renamed `bars.*` by hand, when the run spec's `[data]` table became `[bars]`; no report changed.
On 2026-11-06 examples/universe.toml gave `examples/decision-close.hpp` for `replay.fill = "decision-close"`, the library's rule with the same body: by hand, universe.json's `market_price_rule` became `decision-close` and universe.args gained `replay.fill=decision-close`; no fill changed.
On 2026-11-23 the examples were copied again from atlc 9090625 (`ai/builtin-names`, the first revision with the new names), whose built-ins have new names (`roll_zscore`, `roll_ols(...).slope`, `roll_max`, `ma`); no report or argument changed.
